body:
# **Near Detect**

Near Detect is a lightweight Forge mod for Minecraft 1.16.5 that helps you track nearby players in real time.

# Features
Detects players around you within a custom radius
Shows player distance in blocks
Friend system with quick add support
Animated modern GUI
Toggle the mod ON/OFF instantly
Adjustable near radius
Displays your friend list directly in the GUI
Simple hotkeys for fast usage
# Hotkeys
H → Open Near Detect menu
Right Shift + B → Add player to friends while aiming at them
#  GUI Includes
Radius slider/input
Friend counter
Friend list
Enable/Disable button
Smooth button animations

Perfect For
SMP servers
Survival multiplayer
PvP gameplay
Team coordination
Base defense
